d: DirectFN is a leading Capital Market Industry (CMI) Financial Technology software and Content provider, company (now owned by Saudi Tadawul Group / WAMID) specializes in providing brokerage, asset, and custody management solutions, along with market information screens – as productized services. Our innovative products, services, and solutions empower both financial institutions and individuals to optimize their operations and enhance client satisfaction

The Program Manager at DirectFN is responsible for managing a portfolio of related client delivery projects as a cohesive programme, ensuring that interdependencies are managed, shared resources are optimized, and overall programme outcomes are achieved. This role provides a senior layer of delivery leadership above individual project managers—aligning multiple concurrent implementations under a unified programme governance framework, managing client relationships at a strategic level, and ensuring that the collective delivery of related projects creates integrated value for clients. The Program Manager works closely with the PMO Manager, Delivery Directors, and the Chief Delivery Officer to maintain programme-level visibility and drive successful outcomes across complex, multi-stream engagements.
II. Key Responsibilities1. Programme Planning & Governance
Define and own the programme plan for assigned groups of related delivery projects, establishing an integrated schedule, shared resource plan, and programme-level governance framework.
Identify and actively manage interdependencies, shared milestones, and cross-project risks across the programme.
Establish and chair programme governance forums, including steering committees, programme reviews, and cross-project coordination meetings.
Provide oversight and direction to Project Managers within the programme, ensuring each project is aligned with programme objectives and progressing on schedule.
Maintain a consolidated view of programme health by tracking delivery status, risks, issues, budget utilization, and milestone achievement across all component projects.
Intervene and provide delivery leadership support where individual projects face significant challenges or escalated risks.
Serve as the senior client relationship owner for programme-level engagements, engaging with executive sponsors and senior stakeholders at client organizations.
Lead programme-level client governance meetings, executive briefings, and strategic delivery reviews.
Manage client expectations at the programme level, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, priorities, and outcomes across multiple workstreams.
Oversee programme-level resource planning and allocation, coordinating with the PMO Manager and Delivery Directors to ensure the right capacity and skills are available.
Monitor programme budget utilization, flag variances, and work with delivery management to maintain financial discipline across the programme.
Own the programme-level risk and issue register, ensuring all programme risks are identified, assessed, and actively managed.
Manage programme-level change requests, assessing impact across all component projects and coordinating approvals with relevant stakeholders.
Escalate high-priority programme risks and issues to the PMO Manager and Chief Delivery Officer with recommended mitigation actions.
Produce programme status reports and executive dashboards for the PMO Manager, Chief Delivery Officer, and client leadership, providing an accurate and timely view of programme performance.
Lead programme retrospectives and drive lessons learned into future programme and project planning.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of programme management practices and delivery standards within DirectFN.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related field; a Master's degree is an advantage.
Minimum of 10 years of experience in project or programme management, including at least 4 years managing multi-project programmes in a technology delivery or professional services environment.
Proven ability to manage complex, interdependent delivery programmes with multiple workstreams and stakeholders.
Strong understanding of programme and project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid approaches.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Proficiency with programme management and reporting tools such as MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or equivalent.
Demonstrated experience managing significant programme budgets and multi-disciplinary resource pools across concurrent workstreams.
Experience in fintech, capital markets, or financial services technology delivery is preferred.
Fluent in English (spoken and written); Arabic is an advantage.
PgMP (Program Management Professional), PMP, or MSP certification.
Experience managing delivery programmes for capital markets technology solutions, including Trading Platforms, BMS, or AMS implementations.
Familiarity with GCC client delivery environments and the stakeholder dynamics of financial institutions in the region.
Candidates currently based in Kuwait are preferred.
Previous experience in the banking or brokerage industry is highly preferred.
Programme Leadership: Provides clear direction and strategic oversight across multiple concurrent delivery projects.
Stakeholder Management: Builds and sustains executive-level client relationships with credibility and professionalism.
Integrated Planning: Designs and manages complex programme plans that account for interdependencies and shared resources.
Risk Management: Proactively identifies and manages programme-level risks before they impact delivery outcomes.
Communication: Produces insightful programme reports and confidently leads executive governance forums.
Delivery Focus: Maintains a strong focus on programme outcomes and drives accountability across project teams.
Programme Delivery: Consistent achievement of programme milestones and outcomes across all component projects.
Client Satisfaction: High satisfaction from programme-level client stakeholders regarding delivery quality, communication, and partnership.
Risk & Issue Management: Programme risks and issues proactively managed with minimal impact on delivery outcomes.
Portfolio Visibility: Accurate and timely programme reporting that supports informed decision-making by the PMO Manager and Chief Delivery Officer.
Team Enablement: Project Managers within the programme are effectively supported, aligned, and empowered to deliver successful outcomes.

The Foundations squad owns the platform that makes Lean's AI ambitions real — the shared libraries, developer infrastructure, and agentic loops that engineers across the company depend on every day. As Staff Engineer, you'll be the technical heartbeat of the team: the person who makes the hard architectural calls, keeps standards high under delivery pressure, and ensures that what we build today doesn't become tomorrow's bottleneck.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 350+ clients — from Tabby and Tas'heel to Hungerstation — and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: Staff Engineer level or equivalent — you've operated at this level and know what it means to lead technically without hierarchy
Habitual AI-assisted developer — you use AI tooling as a natural, daily part of how you write, review, and reason about code
Deep backend engineering experience: distributed systems, APIs, and reliability at scale
Java and Spring Boot — our core stack; non-negotiable
Strong system design and architectural judgement: opinionated, defensible, and intellectually honest when better evidence arrives
Active service ownership mindset — observability, alerting, SLOs, and incident response are part of your job, not someone else's
Comfortable leading without authority: you influence through credibility, not title
Strong communicator — you can hold a technical conversation with an engineer and a strategic one with a VP
Invested in the people around you — mentoring and growing junior engineers is something you do because you care, not because it's on your job description
Experience with AI/ML integration or agentic systems (LLM orchestration, agent frameworks, production prompt engineering)
Experience building internal developer platforms or shared libraries
Background in fintech, open banking, payments infrastructure, or financial data APIs

r: Drive architectural decisions for the Foundations squad — setting direction on system design that balances robustness, reliability, and pragmatism, and defending those decisions with clarity
Serve as the technical voice of the team externally — building trusted relationships with other Staff Engineers and EMs across the org, and contributing to Lean's technical advisory group
Own and evolve the team's shared libraries and platform components (including Commons) that the wider engineering organisation depends on
Stay deeply embedded in team operations — spotting friction, championing improvements to processes and service hygiene, and driving change without formal authority
